snippet.title: First Gameplay Preview  |  Ashes of the Singularity II
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499790/

The first gameplay trailer for Ashes of the Singularity II - the massive-scale real time strategy game where you are fighting for control of entire worlds with thousands of units. 

Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.
